contexts.text: No one can ever say that he wills a thing, except from the fact that he lovesit.
I will sing to my beloved...
But men loved darkness more than light. AC 9245.
From a certain love of truth...
The beloved of Jehovah () = spiritual truth which is from celestial good.
To scortate, and love meretricious hire () = to falsify truths and to love things falsified.
What is meant by the Lord's words concerning the love of an enemy. Explained.
I love my lord, my woman, etc. () = the delight of the recollection of spiritual goods. To love = the delight of recollection. Explained.
To love the Assyrians... () = to love reasonings. AE 355:30.
The Africans are loved the most.
That I have loved thee () = that they are loved and are received into Heaven by the Lord.
They loved not their soul even to death () = those who had not loved themselves more than the Lord.
The beloved city () = the doctrine of the New Church.
This is my beloved Son.

To love, when said of the Lord, = that He is present... because dilection or love effects conjunction and consequent presence; and the Lord enters to him who loves... and also gives him to love Him; that is, to do His commandments; for this is to love the Lord... as He Himself teaches in John: He who keeps My precepts and does them, he it is who loveth Me; and He who loveth Me will be loved of My Father; and I will love him... ().
By the beloved son () is meant the Lord as to Divine truth.
My beloved () = the Lord, because He instaurates the Churches.
As they had loved the neighbour...
Abide in My love. If ye keep My commandments ye shall abide in My love ().
They loved () = the love of falsity.
Holy Spirit. 4. 2. No one can receive the Holy Spirit... except him who is in love (to the Lord).
The likeness of God = that man can love, etc., as of himself.
